FILES = ('Build-Transfer.py', 'Python_Settings.bat', 'README.txt', 'Start-Atlas-Demo.bat', 'demo_config.json', 'demo_data.py', 'demo_server.py', 'package_catalog.py', 'snapshot.json.gz', 'web/directory.css', 'web/directory.html', 'web/directory.js', 'web/index.html', 'web/official-app.js', 'web/official-data.json', 'web/official-floor--1.jpg', 'web/official-floor-0.jpg', 'web/official-floor-1.jpg', 'web/official-floor-2.jpg', 'web/official-floor-3.jpg', 'web/official-floor-4.jpg', 'web/official-floor-5.jpg', 'web/official-floor-6.jpg', 'web/official-floor-7.jpg', 'web/official-floor-8.jpg', 'web/official.css', 'web/studio-floor--1.svg', 'web/studio-floor-0.svg', 'web/studio-floor-1.svg', 'web/studio-floor-2.svg', 'web/studio-floor-3.svg', 'web/studio-floor-4.svg', 'web/studio-floor-5.svg', 'web/studio-floor-6.svg', 'web/studio-floor-7.svg', 'web/studio-floor-8.svg', 'web/style.css', 'web/templates/users-and-computers-template.xlsx', 'web/templates/users-and-desks-official-template.xlsx', 'web/templates/users-and-desks-previous-template.xlsx')
MAX_BYTES=1024*1024*1024

def digest(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def safe_name(name):
 p=PurePosixPath(name)
 if not name or p.is_absolute() or '\\' in name or ':' in name or str(p)!=name:
  raise ValueError('Invalid archive path')
 for part in p.parts:
  if part in ('.','..') or part.endswith((' ','.')) or any(ord(x)<32 or x in '<>"|?*' for x in part):raise ValueError('Invalid archive path')
  if part.split('.')[0].upper() in {'CON','PRN','AUX','NUL',*[f'COM{i}' for i in range(1,10)],*[f'LPT{i}' for i in range(1,10)]}:raise ValueError('Reserved archive path')
 return p

def build(root,output):
 root=root.resolve();entries={}
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='wmi_snapshot_') as td:
  for name in FILES:
   path=root/name
   if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink() or root not in path.resolve().parents:raise ValueError('Required file missing or linked: '+name)
   if path.suffix=='.db':
    snapshot=Path(td)/(uuid.uuid4().hex+'.db')
    source=sqlite3.connect(path.resolve().as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True);dest=sqlite3.connect(snapshot)
    try:
     source.backup(dest)
     if dest.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchall()!=[('ok',)]:raise ValueError('Database integrity failure: '+name)
    finally:dest.close();source.close()
    entries[name]=snapshot.read_bytes()
   else:entries[name]=path.read_bytes()
  manifest={'format':'Office-Atlas-ReadOnly-Demo-1','files':[{'path':n,'size':len(b),'sha256':digest(b)} for n,b in sorted(entries.items())]}
  buffer=io.BytesIO()
  with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
   for name,data in sorted(entries.items()):z.writestr(name,data)
   z.writestr('PORTABLE_MANIFEST.json',json.dumps(manifest))
  encoded=base64.b85encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode('ascii')
  template=(root/'Build-Transfer.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
  marker='PAYLOAD = '+chr(34)+chr(34)
  if template.count('\n'+marker+'\n')!=1:raise ValueError('Builder payload marker is invalid')
  wrapped='\n'.join(encoded[i:i+100] for i in range(0,len(encoded),100))
  result=template.replace('\n'+marker+'\n','\nPAYLOAD = """\n'+wrapped+'\n"""\n',1)
  compile(result,str(output),'exec')
  output=output.resolve();output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  temp=output.with_name(output.name+'.'+uuid.uuid4().hex+'.tmp')
  try:temp.write_text(result,encoding='utf-8');os.replace(temp,output)
  finally:temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
  print('Built:',output,'Files:',len(entries),'Bytes:',output.stat().st_size)

def extract(base):
 raw=base64.b85decode(''.join(PAYLOAD.split()).encode('ascii'))
 with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as z:
  infos=z.infolist();names=[i.filename for i in infos]
  if len(infos)>10000 or sum(i.file_size for i in infos)>MAX_BYTES:raise ValueError('Archive exceeds extraction limits')
  if len({n.casefold() for n in names})!=len(names):raise ValueError('Duplicate archive entries')
  for i in infos:
   safe_name(i.filename)
   if i.is_dir() or (i.external_attr>>16)&0o170000==0o120000:raise ValueError('Unexpected directory or link')
  manifest=json.loads(z.read('PORTABLE_MANIFEST.json'))
  if manifest.get('format')!='Office-Atlas-ReadOnly-Demo-1' or not isinstance(manifest.get('files'),list) or not manifest['files']:raise ValueError('Invalid manifest')
  declared={}
  for item in manifest['files']:
   name=item['path'];safe_name(name)
   if name in declared or not isinstance(item.get('size'),int) or item['size']<0:raise ValueError('Invalid manifest entry')
   declared[name]=item
  if set(names)!=set(declared)|{'PORTABLE_MANIFEST.json'} or not set(FILES).issubset(declared):raise ValueError('Archive and manifest file sets differ')
  # Validate all contents before creating any installation directory.
  for name,item in declared.items():
   data=z.read(name)
   if len(data)!=item['size'] or digest(data)!=item['sha256']:raise ValueError('Damaged file: '+name)
  base=base.resolve();base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  destination=base/'Office-Atlas-ReadOnly-Demo'
  if destination.exists():destination=base/('Office-Atlas-ReadOnly-Demo_'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:12])
  temporary=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='wmi_verified_',dir=base))
  try:
   for name in declared:
    path=temporary/name;path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);path.write_bytes(z.read(name))
   for name in ():
    con=sqlite3.connect((temporary/name).as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
    try:
     if con.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchall()!=[('ok',)]:raise ValueError('Database integrity failure')
    finally:con.close()
   if destination.exists():raise FileExistsError('Destination appeared during extraction; retry')
   temporary.rename(destination)
  finally:
   if temporary.exists():shutil.rmtree(temporary)
 print('Extracted and verified:',destination)
 print('Existing installations and databases were not changed.')
 print('Read README.txt. Set Python_Settings.bat, then run Start-Atlas-Demo.bat.')
 return destination

def main():
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--source',type=Path,default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent);p.add_argument('--output',type=Path);p.add_argument('--destination',type=Path,default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent);a=p.parse_args()
 if PAYLOAD.strip():extract(a.destination)
 else:build(a.source,a.output or a.source/'Office-Atlas-ReadOnly-Demo-Transfer.txt')

if __name__=='__main__':
 try:main()
 except Exception as exc:raise SystemExit('FAILED: '+str(exc))
